title: Moman Khan Is Sent Against the Singhs

blocks.text: Episode 85 opens with administrative fury, counting jitnak bind singhan ki parai and discussing how captured Sikhs should be broken through exemplary punishment.
The cruelty is explicit in phard singhan than mangaiai daîai mungran sôn kutvâi, after which the order hardens into mârô singhan kó ab jai and turns policy talk into operational command.
The page closes the setup by naming the officer who will act on that order, because ghalyô môman khan phaujdar marks the dispatch of the expedition that now advances against the Singhs.
